stem: An analyst computes the LTV of Business Care, Voltmarkt's device-support subscription for small offices, as ARPA / monthly logo churn, leaving out gross margin. What does this do to the figure?

options.text: It turns LTV into a number of months instead of euros
It overstates LTV, since it counts revenue instead of gross profit
It understates LTV, since gross margin adds value to every euro
Nothing changes, since gross margin cancels out against churn
